title: DIR-078: Ingest Super Admin Branding Logo & Eliminate Top Whitespace in Cuba App Chrome
spec: MISSION & CONTEXT: The candidate dashboard chrome currently exhibits two visual and architectural defects: 1. Missing Real Logo: In CubaAppShell.jsx and child chrome, the brand tile displays a hardcoded 32x32 CSS gradient box with a unicode star (✦) and static text 'IME365 AI Executive Suite'. It completely ignores getSystemSettings().branding (logoUrl, darkLogoUrl, brandName) configured and uploaded by the Super Admin in BrandingSettings.jsx, as well as the official bundled fallback asset (src/assets/logo/logo.png). 2. Excessive Top Whitespace: The sticky top bar (h-[var(--cuba-header-h)], 64px) spans full width across the sidebar and main workspace, leaving a massive blank empty glass void on the left above the sidebar. Furthermore, the main workspace container has stacked vertical padding (py-6 + breadcrumbs mb-4 + shell space-y-6 = ~148px vertical drop), pushing the Hero card down and wasting prime above-the-fold screen space. MANDATORY ARCHITECTURAL REQUIREMENTS: 1. Super Admin Dynamic Branding Ingestion (CubaAppShell.jsx): - Ingest branding configuration from getSystemSettings(): branding.logoUrl, branding.darkLogoUrl, and branding.brandName. - Dynamic Logo Resolution: * If theme === 'dark' and branding.darkLogoUrl is set, use branding.darkLogoUrl. * Else if branding.logoUrl is set, use branding.logoUrl. * Fallback: use official bundled high-resolution asset src/assets/logo/logo.png (or import logo from '../../assets/logo/logo.png'). * If image load fails (onError), fail gracefully to a clean brand mark. - Render Authentic Logo: * In expanded brand tile: render the authentic logo image (). * In collapsed icon rail: render the brand mark/glyph cleanly centered. * In mobile drawer (data-testid='cuba-mobile-drawer'): render the authentic logo image and brand name instead of the generic ✦ box. 2. Eliminate Top Whitespace & Header Left Void: - Header Left Rail Harmonization: * Anchor the top-left section of the sticky header with the authentic brand logo (or seamlessly connect the brand identity to y=0) so the top-left corner of the application is never an empty dead glass void. * Keep the sidebar collapse chevron () accessible and properly aligned. - Main Canvas Top Padding Tightening: * In CubaAppShell.jsx main container, reduce the top padding from py-6 to pt-2.5 pb-24 md:pt-3 md:pb-6 (or pt-3 pb-24 sm:px-6 md:pb-6 lg:px-8). * Reduce breadcrumbs bottom margin from mb-4 to mb-2.5. * In CubaCandidateShell.jsx, tighten the top container spacing from space-y-6 to space-y-4 md:space-y-5. * Update tests/dir048-shell-and-controls.test.mjs and tests/dir077-candidate-dashboard-overhaul.test.mjs assertions to match the updated container padding. 3. Verification & Regression Protection: - Create tests/dir078-branding-logo-and-top-whitespace.test.mjs asserting: * getSystemSettings().branding logo ingestion with fallback to logo.png. * Real rendering in expanded sidebar and mobile drawer with alt text. * Zero hardcoded ✦ placeholder boxes. * Tightened top padding classes on main content container. - Run gates: dir078, dir077, dir048-shell-and-controls, test:product, test:security:static, test:xampp-policy, build (<4s), 0 lint errors, 0 diff on frozen CV templates.

plan.summary: DIR-078 P0 recon complete, every finding cited to file:line. INVARIANTS AND CONTRACT BOUNDARIES: XAMPP-only servers (no detached node/vite daemon); preserve dir074, dir075, dir076, dir077, cuba-candidate-portal, cuba-design-system and dir048-shell-and-controls; zero fabrication; no auth, token or API contract change; sub-4s build; 0 lint errors; 55 frozen CV templates diff 0. RCA AND FINDINGS: (1) CubaAppShell.jsx:419-471 (post DIR-077) renders a hardcoded 32px gradient box with the unicode star and static IME365 AI Executive Suite text, and the mobile drawer at :488-494 renders the same star box plus IME365 Career Suite; neither reads getSystemSettings().branding, and the bundled src/assets/logo/logo.png is unused (CubaCandidateShell.jsx:38 imports logo but never uses it, an existing lint warning). (2) getSystemSettings() (platform.js:2221) exposes branding.brandName, branding.logoUrl, branding.darkLogoUrl, branding.faviconUrl and branding.defaultAvatarUrl, and its env default leaves logoUrl and darkLogoUrl EMPTY (platform.js:2290), so the bundled logo MUST be the fallback. (3) The sticky header (CubaAppShell.jsx:274) is full width with an EMPTY aria-hidden spacer as its left rail (:302), so the top-left corner above the sidebar is a dead glass void. (4) The main container (:514) is px-4 py-6 pb-24 sm:px-6 md:pb-6 lg:px-8 with breadcrumbs mb-4 (:519) and a shell space-y-6 (CubaCandidateShell.jsx:456), a stacked drop of roughly 148px. (5) Two pinned assertions must move in lockstep: dir048-shell-and-controls.test.mjs:51 and dir077-candidate-dashboard-overhaul.test.mjs AC1 and AC2. CHANGES: (1) CubaAppShell imports the bundled logo and getSystemSettings, holds branding state plus a logoFailed flag, fetches branding best-effort on mount, and resolves activeLogo as darkLogoUrl when the theme is dark and it is set, else logoUrl, else the bundled logo, with brandName falling back to IME365; onError degrades to a clean text-bearing brand mark. (2) The header left rail renders the authentic logo image (alt equals brandName, h-8 md:h-9 w-auto max-w-[150px] object-contain shrink-0) inside a home link on md and up so the top-left is never a dead void, while the collapse chevron keeps its aria-label, aria-pressed and 40px hit area and stays aligned. (3) The expanded sidebar pill keeps the ContextSwitcher, and the collapsed icon rail renders the brand mark cleanly centered. (4) The mobile drawer (data-testid cuba-mobile-drawer) renders the authentic logo image plus the brand name instead of the star box. (5) Tighten the top spacing: main container px-4 pt-2.5 pb-24 sm:px-6 md:pt-3 md:pb-6 lg:px-8, breadcrumbs mb-2.5, and CubaCandidateShell space-y-4 md:space-y-5, updating the dir048 and dir077 assertions. ACCESSIBILITY (WCAG 2.1 AA): the logo img carries a real alt of brandName, the fallback mark keeps an accessible name, exactly one banner header and one breadcrumb nav remain, the chevron keeps its accessible name and 40px target, cuba-focusable keyboard focus rings are preserved and contrast stays at or above 4.5 to 1 with Cuba tokens. UX STATES: the branding read is best-effort chrome, so the bundled logo renders immediately while it loads (no layout shift and no skeleton needed), and a failed image or failed read degrades gracefully to the brand mark rather than an empty or error banner in the chrome. RESPONSIVE: the header logo shows from md up while the hamburger serves below md, the drawer brand row is validated at 375px mobile, and the tightened padding is validated at 375px, 768px, 1280px and 1680px. PERFORMANCE: the branding resolution is memoised and reuses the shell existing best-effort settings pattern, so there is no new fetch waterfall in the render path and no extra re-render loop, keeping the sub-100ms render budget and the sub-4s build. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA: AC1 branding is ingested from getSystemSettings with dark, light and bundled fallback resolution; AC2 a real img with alt text renders in the header, the sidebar and the mobile drawer; AC3 zero hardcoded star placeholder boxes remain; AC4 the tightened top padding classes are applied to the main container, the breadcrumbs and the candidate shell; AC5 the dir048 and dir077 assertions are updated; AC6 all pinned suites pass; AC7 build under 4s; AC8 lint 0 errors; AC9 the 55 frozen CV templates diff 0. TEST PLAN: new tests/dir078-branding-logo-and-top-whitespace.test.mjs asserting AC1 through AC5, plus preserved dir077, dir048-shell-and-controls, dir074, dir075, dir076, cuba-design-system and cuba-candidate-portal. RISK AND ROLLBACK: blast radius is two shell files plus two test files; no data, auth, routing or API change; rollback is a single git revert. VERIFICATION: npm run test:dir078, test:dir077, test:dir076, test:design-system, test:product, test:security:static, test:xampp-policy, npm run build under 4s, npm run lint 0 errors, frozen cv-templates diff 0.
